title: Destructure and spread

blocks.promptMd: After `const b = { ...a, south: 2 }` with `a = { east: 3, south: 0 }`, `a.south` is…
> `extendSouth({ east: 3, south: 0 })` returns a new object with `south: 2`. Print that south value.

hintLadder.md: The starter writes straight into the record it was handed, so the caller loses the original.
Build a new object instead: spread the old fields in, then override the one you meant to change.
`{ ...settings, volume: 3 }` copies every field and replaces only `volume`.

description: Pull fields out of a record, or copy them into a new one.
